semantics: Installation Readiness — a SEPARATE metric: can another technical specialist install KimyoLab with the documented commands, without writing code, discovering paths or repairing the build? It is NOT an input of foundation, learning product or the overall estimate, and it says nothing about learning content, assessment or human governance (they stay separate debts).
formula: percent = passed checks / total checks (every check below is the denominator; no weighting, no hidden items)

statusRule.READY_IN_SIMULATION: every check passes LOCALLY / in simulation (the /kimyolab/ mount served by the bundled server and the clean-environment drill, on the machine that generated this report). It does not include a remote CI result.
statusRule.READY_FOR_DEPLOYMENT: additionally a VALID target-server acceptance record exists (scripts/lib/target-acceptance.ts: schema, this exact artefact sha256, content version and mount, a real non-local HTTPS origin, a human actor, preflight and smoke PASS, decision ACCEPTED). An agent writes only the template; it never writes an accepted record.

evidenceModel: The deployment reports are regenerated by every CI run (strict readiness is the CI gate). A committed copy is current only while `evidence-current` passes: it ties every report to THIS artefact sha256, configuration, content version and the resolved rollback baseline.

checks.label: production build reproducible
deploy artefact known (path, mount, file count, sha256, content version)
all deployment evidence describes THIS artefact, configuration, content version and the resolved rollback baseline
checks.evidence: preflight / smoke / rollback / clean-drill reports vs the deploy manifest and the rollback resolver

checks.label: configuration documented in one place
no hardcoded host, domain or deployment path
portal subpath simulation works (/kimyolab/)
direct deep link and refresh work
assets and content load from the mount
learner storage namespaced by mount
Web Locks namespaced by mount
no service worker can escape the mount
CSS isolated from the host page
nothing is served outside the mount
deploy:preflight exists and passes
deploy:smoke passes against the built artefact
standalone delivery passes (offline, model-based, progress, brand, integrity)
integrity / checksum enforced and failing closed
rollback drill passes with real artefacts; learner evidence kept
failures give DEPLOY_* codes, a fix and no absolute path or stack trace
checks.evidence: self-test: preflight of a deliberately broken copy

checks.label: clean-environment drill passes with the documented commands
Linux verification runner pinned (ubuntu-24.04), no *-latest anywhere
Windows path job pinned (windows-2025) and runs path tests + deploy preflight
GitHub Actions on Node-24 runtime majors; application Node from .nvmrc
the CI workflow runs verify, build, preflight, smoke, both drills, the cross-platform artefact comparison and strict readiness

externalAcceptance.note: valid records = 0 → no real target-server installation has been accepted; no real portal integration is claimed

ciResult: not established here: live GitHub CI success is an external merge gate (the PR checks), never asserted by repository-local code

knownDebtNotInThisMetric.feedback: 29 form simulations without a wrong-answer verdict, 6 experiments without enforced step order (P2.9)
knownDebtNotInThisMetric.content: assessment, structured theory, human review and release decisions
